title: High 5xx error rate — orders service (bad deploy, revision 12)
description: The orders deployment in rlvr-target began returning HTTP 500 on the /checkout path immediately after revision 12 rolled the image to rlvr/orders:v2-broken. The error rate spiked to 8% (SLO: 1%) across both running pods. Pods are healthy at the runtime level (no crashloop, memory and CPU under limits); the fault is entirely in the application code introduced by the new image.

_ground_truth.root_cause: Deployment revision 12 rolled out a broken image (rlvr/orders:v2-broken) containing a nil pointer dereference in checkoutHandler. The /checkout endpoint panics on every request due to an uninitialized PriceQuote struct in v2, causing 8% of requests to return HTTP 500. The DB pool is healthy (22/100), CPU and memory are within limits — the fault is entirely in the new application code.
resolution_steps: Identify the bad revision: kubectl rollout history deployment/orders -n rlvr-target
Roll back to the previous revision: kubectl rollout undo deployment/orders -n rlvr-target
Verify rollback: kubectl rollout status deployment/orders -n rlvr-target
Confirm error rate returns below SLO: app_error_rate < 0.01
